thread:
sara: Quick proposal for Monday: introduce an overage-smoothing window + soft caps per tier to reduce surprise bills and support steady degradation instead of hard drops. Thoughts?

mike: I like the smoothing idea. customers hate sudden spikes. can you sketch numbers? :+1:

sara: rough sketch: allow burst credits + a moving 1h smoothing window. example for Standard tier: burst_credits=10k tokens, smoothing_window=1h, soft_cap=200 rps, hard_cap=600 rps. overages billed with a 24h amortized smoothing factor.
jun: can you put that as config snippet? easier to discuss.
sara: sure: ```
{
  tier: "standard",
  burst_credits: "10k_tokens",
  smoothing_window: "1h",
  soft_cap_rps: 200,
  hard_cap_rps: 600,
  overage_rate: "$0.015_per_token_amortized"
}
```

olga: two quick flags: 1) billing and ledger needs to show both instantaneous and amortized charge, 2) product docs must make clear when soft cap => degraded latency vs hard cap => 429.

ryan: infra question: can runtime enforce soft cap via queueing + graceful shedding, or do we need separate quota-service changes?
mike: runtime can queue for a short period but we should avoid head-of-line blocking. prefer token-bucket with dynamic refill using smoothing window.

sara: right — implementation plan: quota service adds smoothing window calc, runtime uses soft cap with short queue (200ms), then shed to fallback model or return 429 depending on route policy.

jun: launch criteria proposal: docs + billing UI change, end-to-end test with simulated spikes, telemetry for amortized vs instant, customer communications draft, and two pilot customers.

olga: add legal/finance signoff for overage pricing. also needs clear example calc page for customers.

ryan: rollout plan: feature flag + canary (5% tenants) -> 5 pilot customers -> 25% -> GA. monitor error rate, latency p50/p95, billing divergence metric. revert plan ready to toggle smoothing off.

mike: one more ask: include an opt-out for existing committed contracts (checkbox in billing portal) to avoid violating SLA terms.
sara: good call. include contract opt-out & automatic notice.

billing-bot: heads up: prototype billing export will include fields: burst_credits_used, amortized_overage_amount, smoothing_window_seconds. will produce sample CSV.

jun: next steps: sara to add RFC doc with concrete numbers + sample invoices, olga to draft customer-facing examples, ryan to produce infra effort estimate. meeting to sync Wed 10am.

sara: thanks — will post RFC before EOD tomorrow. :memo:
